MPC_ENGINEERING.title: MPC Stream (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry)
MPC_ENGINEERING.summary: The premier gateway for engineering, architecture, physical sciences, and technical innovation across AP, TS, and national institutions.
highSchoolFocus: Maths 1A/2A: Functions, Matrices, Complex Numbers, Probability & Calculus
Maths 1B/2B: 2D/3D Coordinate Geometry, Differentiation & Integration
Physics: Mechanics, Electromagnetism, Optics & Modern Physics
Chemistry: Physical, Inorganic & Organic Chemistry fundamentals
entranceExams: State CETs: AP EAPCET / TG EAPCET (Engineering Stream)
National Level: JEE Main & JEE Advanced (IITs, NITs, IIITs)
Deemed/Private Universities: BITSAT, VITEEE, SRMJEEE, MET
Defense & Others: UPSC NDA, NATA (Architecture Paper 2)
undergradDegrees: B.Tech / B.E. (Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, ECE, EEE)
B.Tech in Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace, or Robotics Engineering
B.Sc / BS in Data Science, Computing, or Applied Mathematics
freeResources: Telugu Academy / State Board Standard Textbooks
CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science (Harvard / edX)

nodes.label: Differential Calculus & Coordinate Geometry
nodes.description: Functions, limits, and derivative techniques for mechanics and curves.

BIPC_MEDICINE.title: BiPC Stream (Biology, Physics, Chemistry)
BIPC_MEDICINE.summary: Targeted pathway for clinical healthcare, medical surgery, pharmaceuticals, agricultural sciences, and biotechnology research.
highSchoolFocus: Botany: Plant Physiology, Morphology, Diversity, and Genetics
Zoology: Human Anatomy, Physiology, Animal Diversity, and Evolution
Physics & Chemistry: Same core syllabus as MPC with medical entrance weightage
Regular practical lab work and NCERT line-by-line mastery
entranceExams: National Level: NEET-UG (MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, BVSc)
State Level: AP EAPCET / TG EAPCET (Agriculture & Pharmacy Stream)
Central & Research: ICAR AIEEA (via CUET-UG), AIIMS B.Sc Nursing
Research Institutes: NEST / IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
undergradDegrees: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS (Clinical Medicine & Surgery)
B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Fishery Science

PCMB_HYBRID.title: PCMB Stream (Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology)
PCMB_HYBRID.summary: Interdisciplinary dual-math track bridging biological systems with computational modeling, bioinformatics, and biomedical engineering.
highSchoolFocus: Higher Mathematics combined with Genetics and Cell Biology
Biophysics, Organic Reaction Mechanisms, and Physical Chemistry
Dual preparation managing both medical and technical problem solving
entranceExams: Engineering Stream: AP/TG EAPCET (Eng) & JEE Main
Medical & Agri Stream: NEET-UG & AP/TG EAPCET (Agri/Pharma)
Science & Research: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT), NEST, CUET-UG
undergradDegrees: B.Tech / BS in Bioinformatics & Computational Biology
BS-MS Dual Degree at IISER / IISc Bangalore

MEC_COMMERCE_DATA.title: MEC Stream (Mathematics, Economics, Commerce)
MEC_COMMERCE_DATA.summary: Combines analytical calculus and statistics with commerce and economic systems, ideal for FinTech, quantitative finance, and CA/CMA careers.
highSchoolFocus: Commercial Mathematics, Algebra, Linear Programming & Statistics
Accountancy: Double-entry bookkeeping, final accounts, ledgers & depreciation
Economics: Microeconomics, Macroeconomics & Indian Economic Development
entranceExams: Professional Certifications: CA Foundation (ICAI), CMA Foundation (ICMAI)
Management: IPMAT (IIM Indore/Rohtak 5-Year Integrated BBA+MBA), JIPMAT
University Entrances: CUET-UG (DU, Central Universities), AP/TS LAWCET
State Degree Admissions: OAMDC (AP) / DOST (TS) for degree colleges

CEC_COMMERCE_MANAGEMENT.title: CEC Stream (Commerce, Economics, Civics)
CEC_COMMERCE_MANAGEMENT.summary: Focuses on corporate management, commercial law, civil governance, and banking without advanced calculus pressure.
highSchoolFocus: Accountancy, Auditing & Financial Accounting principles
Civics & Governance: Indian Constitution, Parliament, and Public Administration
Economics: Trade, Banking, Monetary Policy, and Commercial Growth
entranceExams: Professional Law: AP LAWCET / TS LAWCET (5-Year Integrated Law)
National Law: CLAT-UG, AILET (National Law Universities)
Finance & Accounting: CA Foundation, CMA Foundation
Central Universities: CUET-UG (Commerce & Business streams)
freeResources: NCERT Political Science and Constitution Textbooks

HEC_HUMANITIES_ARTS.title: HEC Stream (History, Economics, Civics)
HEC_HUMANITIES_ARTS.summary: The definitive foundation for constitutional law, public administration, national civil services (UPSC/APPSC), and design disciplines.
highSchoolFocus: History: Ancient, Medieval, Modern Indian & World History
Civics: Constitution of India, Political Theory & Human Rights
Economics: Socio-economic planning, rural economics & public finance
entranceExams: Law Entrances: AP LAWCET / TS LAWCET (5-Year Law), CLAT-UG
Central Universities: CUET-UG (Humanities, Social Sciences)
Design & Media: UCEED, NID-DAT, NIFT, IHM-JEE (Hotel Management)
State Degree Portals: AP OAMDC / TS DOST (Direct degree counseling)
undergradDegrees: B.A. LL.B (5-Year Integrated National Law Degree)
B.A. (Honours) in Political Science, Public Administration, or History

POLYTECHNIC_DIPLOMA.title: Polytechnic Diploma in Engineering
POLYTECHNIC_DIPLOMA.summary: A practical, laboratory-first technical pathway providing direct lateral admission into the 2nd year of B.Tech.
highSchoolFocus: Workshop technology, engineering drawing, and circuit labs
Applied Physics, Chemistry, and Engineering Mathematics
Specialized core branch electives (CME, ECE, Mechanical, Civil)
entranceExams: Initial Entry Exam: POLYCET (AP POLYCET / TG POLYCET post 10th)
Lateral Entry Exam: ECET (AP ECET / TG ECET for direct 2nd-year B.Tech entry)
undergradDegrees: Lateral Entry B.Tech (2nd Year Direct in State Engineering Colleges)
Associate Engineer Industry Roles (PSUs, Railways, State Transco/Genco)
freeResources: State Board of Technical Education & Training (SBTET) Notes

VOCATIONAL_SELF_PACED.title: Vocational & Applied Technical Track
VOCATIONAL_SELF_PACED.stream: Vocational Intermediate / National Skills Qualification Framework
VOCATIONAL_SELF_PACED.summary: Applied, hands-on certification track focusing on direct technician roles, paramedical labs, or specialized software support.
highSchoolFocus: Domain practicals (Computer Science, Medical Lab Tech, Automobile)
Basic Accounting, Office Administration, or System Servicing
On-the-job training (OJT) and apprenticeship hours
entranceExams: State Vocational Bridge Courses for EAPCET / Degree lateral options
Apprenticeship Eligibility Tests (NAPS / NSDC)
undergradDegrees: B.Voc (Bachelor of Vocation in Software Development / MLT)
Regular degree entry via bridge examination
Direct Junior Field Technician & Lab Roles
